channel.title: Huiyu Chen — Writing
channel.description: Notes on models, systems, and being human — in English and Chinese.

item.title: 所有推荐任务都能改写成一句话吗？｜生成式推荐 05：P5
item.description: P5 把评分、下一项推荐、解释、评论理解与直接推荐统一成 text-to-text：同一个模型、同一种损失，只改变 personalized prompt。

item.title: 一个模型承包召回、排序、解释和创作｜生成式推荐 06：M6-Rec
item.description: M6-Rec 把统一推荐推进到真实工业链路：召回、CTR、解释、对话和内容创作共享语言底座，再用 option tuning、late interaction 与蒸馏控制成本。

item.title: 通用 LLM 并不天然懂“喜欢”｜生成式推荐 07：TALLRec
item.description: TALLRec 用少量 recommendation instruction 与 LoRA 把 LLaMA 对齐到偏好预测，并用接近随机的零样本表现证明：语言知识不等于推荐知识。

item.title: 上下文放得下，不等于模型看得懂｜生成式推荐 08：ReLLa
item.description: ReLLa 发现 LLM 在远未用满 context window 时就无法利用更长行为序列，并用目标相关行为检索 SUBR 与混合样本微调 ReiT 提高信噪比。

item.title: 世界知识与协同行为怎样合体？｜生成式推荐 09：LLaRA
item.description: LLaRA 把传统序列推荐器的 Item ID embedding 投影成行为 token，与商品标题 token 拼接，并通过 curriculum learning 让 LLM 同时利用世界知识与协同规律。

item.title: 如果检索不再查索引，而是直接生成 ID｜生成式推荐 10：DSI
item.description: DSI 把文档写进模型参数，让同一个 Transformer 同时学习 document→ID 与 query→ID；检索从向量近邻搜索变成了受条件约束的 ID 生成。

item.title: 给每件商品一个语义地址｜生成式推荐 11：TIGER
item.description: TIGER 用 RQ-VAE 把商品内容压缩成粗到细的 Semantic ID，再让 T5 逐 token 生成下一件商品，为生成式推荐建立了经典范式。

item.title: Top-K 不是唯一答案，列表也可以逐件写｜生成式推荐 12：GPTRec
item.description: GPTRec 对比一次打分的 Top-K 与逐件生成的 Next-K，并用 SVD 量化把每件商品表示成多个紧凑 token。

item.title: 语义相似，不等于被同一群人喜欢｜生成式推荐 13：LC-Rec
item.description: LC-Rec 用 Semantic ID 连接 LLaMA 与商品目录，再通过显式、隐式对齐任务把语言语义和协同语义写进同一模型。

item.title: 好 ID 要懂内容、共现与均衡｜生成式推荐 14：LETTER
item.description: LETTER 把层次语义、协同对齐与码本多样性写进同一个 tokenizer 目标，并用 ranking-guided generation 改善生成排序。

item.title: Tokenizer 不该只是离线预处理｜生成式推荐 15：ETEGRec
item.description: ETEGRec 用序列—商品与偏好—语义两类对齐损失连接 tokenizer 和生成器，再通过交替优化让商品 ID 与用户表示共同演化。

item.title: 推荐模型也存在 Scaling Law 吗？｜生成式推荐 16：HSTU
item.description: HSTU 把工业推荐重写为用户行为的 sequential transduction，并从注意力、采样、内核和服务四层解决长序列规模化。

item.title: 召回和排序，能否由一个模型一次完成？｜生成式推荐 17：OneRec
item.description: OneRec 用 Balanced Semantic ID、Session-wise Generation、Sparse MoE 与迭代 DPO，把快手的召回—粗排—精排漏斗改写为一次列表生成。

item.title: 传统交叉特征真的应该全部扔掉吗？｜生成式推荐 18：MTGR
item.description: MTGR 保留 DLRM 的候选交叉特征，把同一用户的多候选聚合成一个 HSTU 序列，并用 GLN 与动态遮罩兼顾规模化、效果与因果安全。

item.title: 推荐也需要先想后答吗？｜生成式推荐 19：OneRec-Think
item.description: OneRec-Think 先将商品 code 对齐到语言空间，再用推荐 CoT 与 Rollout-Beam GRPO 激活推理，并以 Think-Ahead 把慢思考拆到离线。

item.title: 会写思维链，不等于会推理｜生成式推荐 20：OneReason
item.description: OneReason 将推荐推理拆成 item perception 与 preference cognition，用四层任务、专才再统一的强化学习和快慢系统，回答“为什么 thinking mode 真的有效”。

item.title: Can Every Recommendation Task Become a Sentence? | Generative Recommendation 05: P5
item.description: P5 rewrites rating, next-item prediction, explanation, review understanding, and direct recommendation as text-to-text: one model and one loss, with personalized prompts defining the task.

item.title: One Model for Retrieval, Ranking, Explanation, and Creation | Generative Recommendation 06: M6-Rec
item.description: M6-Rec brings unified recommendation into a production stack: retrieval, CTR ranking, explanation, dialogue, and content creation share a language foundation, while option tuning, late interaction, and distillation control cost.

item.title: A General LLM Does Not Naturally Understand “Like” | Generative Recommendation 07: TALLRec
item.description: TALLRec aligns LLaMA with preference prediction using a small number of recommendation instructions and LoRA—and uses near-random zero-shot performance to show that language knowledge is not recommendation knowledge.

item.title: Fitting in Context Is Not the Same as Being Understood | Generative Recommendation 08: ReLLa
item.description: ReLLa finds that LLMs fail to benefit from longer behavior sequences far below their context limit, then raises signal-to-noise with target-conditioned behavior retrieval (SUBR) and mixed-sample tuning (ReiT).

item.title: How Can World Knowledge and Collaborative Behavior Merge? | Generative Recommendation 09: LLaRA
item.description: LLaRA projects a sequential recommender’s Item ID embedding into a behavioral token, concatenates it with title tokens, and uses curriculum learning so the LLM can exploit both world knowledge and collaborative patterns.

item.title: What If Retrieval Generated IDs Instead of Looking Them Up? | Generative Recommendation 10: DSI
item.description: DSI writes documents into model parameters and trains one Transformer on document-to-ID and query-to-ID mappings, turning retrieval into conditional ID generation.

item.title: Give Every Item a Semantic Address | Generative Recommendation 11: TIGER
item.description: TIGER compresses item content into coarse-to-fine Semantic IDs with an RQ-VAE, then trains T5 to generate the next item's address token by token.

item.title: Top-K Is Not the Only Answer: A List Can Be Written Item by Item | Generative Recommendation 12: GPTRec
item.description: GPTRec contrasts one-pass Top-K scoring with autoregressive Next-K list generation and quantizes SVD item coordinates into compact multi-token IDs.

item.title: Semantically Similar Does Not Mean Liked by the Same People | Generative Recommendation 13: LC-Rec
item.description: LC-Rec connects LLaMA to a catalog through Semantic IDs, then uses explicit and implicit translation tasks to align language and collaborative semantics.

item.title: A Good ID Must Understand Content, Co-occurrence, and Balance | Generative Recommendation 14: LETTER
item.description: LETTER writes hierarchical semantics, collaborative alignment, and code diversity into one tokenizer objective, then adds ranking-guided generation.

item.title: The Tokenizer Should Not Be Merely Offline Preprocessing | Generative Recommendation 15: ETEGRec
item.description: ETEGRec connects the tokenizer and generator with sequence–item and preference–semantic alignment, then alternates optimization so item IDs and user states co-evolve.

item.title: Do Recommender Models Have Scaling Laws? | Generative Recommendation 16: HSTU
item.description: HSTU reformulates industrial recommendation as sequential transduction over user actions and tackles long-sequence scaling across attention, sampling, kernels, and serving.

item.title: Can One Model Retrieve and Rank in a Single Pass? | Generative Recommendation 17: OneRec
item.description: OneRec combines balanced Semantic IDs, session-wise generation, Sparse MoE, and iterative DPO to replace Kuaishou's retrieve–prerank–rank funnel with one list generator.

item.title: Should We Really Throw Away Every Traditional Cross Feature? | Generative Recommendation 18: MTGR
item.description: MTGR preserves DLRM candidate crosses, aggregates many candidates into one HSTU user sequence, and uses GLN plus dynamic masks to combine scale, quality, and causal safety.
